svg.title: A-102 Second Floor Plan
svg.text: OPENABLE WINDOWS TO EAST BOUNDARY, ABOVE +3.00
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Two one-bedroom apartments, both entered off the protected
fire lobby: apartment A occupies block A around the core,
apartment B the whole of block B.
2. Both units are planned open: living, dining and
kitchenette read as one room with no corridor, and every
other room is reached directly from the entry hall.
Kitchenettes are a single joinery run — sink, two-ring
3. Wet rooms stack floor to floor onto the party wall spine.
The riser cupboard carrying the soil, water and extract
risers is entered from the fire lobby, not from either
apartment; apartment A's kitchenette drains east to it in
4. East boundary openings: the adjoining plot is limited to
3.00 m in height, so the east wall is opened above that
level and apartment B's bathroom is naturally ventilated.
Openings in a boundary wall are subject to local fire
separation and rights of light rules; confirm before
5. Balconies cantilever 1.20 m beyond the south wall with a
1.10 m parapet, falling 1:80 to an outlet. Escape is by
the single protected stair with FD30S self-closing doors
onto the lobby and sprinklers throughout — a proposal, to
be verified against the governing code.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P2 2026-09-24 east windows, taller floors, garden on A-100
P3 2026-09-29 four storeys, apartments, straight north boundary
